name: War Banners
summary: At Menethil Harbor, Captain Stoutfist sends Alliance champions against Dragonmaw orcs gathering strength in the Wetlands. He wants their war banners claimed from a camp northeast of town.

sections.title: Remnants of the Dragonmaw
sections.body: The Dragonmaw clan once held the red dragonflight captive at Grim Batol during the Second War. When that control broke, the freed dragons hunted their captors nearly to extinction. The few orcs who survived fled Grim Batol into the high mountains east of Whelgar's Excavation, hiding from the red flight's wrath.

sections.title: A Rising Encampment
sections.body: Dragonmaw survivors have gathered again northeast of Menethil Harbor. They have raised a war camp and planted crimson standards in the marsh. Captain Stoutfist sees danger in an armed orc force so near the harbor town. He wants their ranks cut down and their banners torn away as proof of defeat.

sections.title: The Legacy of Nekros
sections.body: Nek'rosh leads the regrouped Dragonmaw orcs. He is the son of Nekros, the warlock who once commanded captive red dragons through dark sorcery. When that magic failed, Nekros was torn apart by the dragons he had held. His son now commands the survivors, consumed by vengeance against the great beasts that killed his father.

faq.q: Who are the Dragonmaw orcs in the Wetlands?
faq.answer: The Dragonmaw orcs in the Wetlands are survivors of a clan that enslaved the red dragonflight during the Second War. The freed dragons hunted them, scattering those who survived Grim Batol into the mountains and marshes.

faq.q: Why does Captain Stoutfist want their war banners?
faq.answer: Captain Stoutfist wants their banners as proof that Alliance soldiers have struck the camp and weakened its fighting strength. The encampment northeast of Menethil Harbor threatens the town.

faq.q: What happened to the Dragonmaw clan's dragons?
faq.answer: When the dark magic holding them failed, the red dragons turned on their Dragonmaw captors. They hunted the orcs across Khaz Modan and decimated the clan.

faq.q: Who leads the Dragonmaw clan now?
faq.answer: Nek'rosh leads the Dragonmaw survivors. He is Nekros's son and has rallied the orcs in vengeance against the red dragons who killed his father.

faq.q: Where did the Dragonmaw hide before setting up this camp?
faq.answer: After fleeing Grim Batol, the surviving orcs hid in the rugged mountains east of Whelgar's Excavation. They later entered the Wetlands marsh and built their camp.

faq.q: Are these Dragonmaw orcs affiliated with Thrall's Horde?
faq.answer: No. The Dragonmaw remnants act outside Warchief Thrall's new Horde in Kalimdor. They are renegades driven by vengeance and survival.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you can see why Captain Stoutfist wants the Dragonmaw driven from Menethil Harbor's vicinity. Their camp threatens the shipping corridor linking Stormwind, Ironforge, and the northern realms.
As a dwarf, you know the Dragonmaw defiled the ancient stronghold of Grim Batol and brought war to the mountains around it. Each Dragonmaw warrior who falls brings a measure of long-delayed justice.
As a warrior, you face hardened veterans of the Second War in their camp. They fight with reckless force, even without their draconic mounts.
